item.title: Correct my if I am wrong. Thank you
item.content:encoded:
When SCP-978 is used on Dr. Clef after the argument with Dr. Bright,the girl's identity should be

+ Spoiler alert for background of Dr. Clef and multiple tales
- Hide

Dáiríne (refer to A Suicide Story), known as KTE-9927-Black ("The Goddess") by the Global Occult Coalition (refer to Agent Ukelele).
She was part goat, part human , had hooves for feet, starlight in her eyes (Refer to Addendum 166-E). She was a type-Black/Green (Semi-Deity,Reality Bender according to classification of Global Occult Coalition), lover of Dr. Clef. That time Dr. Clef was known as Agent Ukelele, still working for Global Occult Coalition when he met her (refer to A Suicide Story/Agent Ukelele). Apparently both of them had a child named Epon (refer to A Suicide Story), known as KTE-9927-Blackchild by the Global Occult Coalition (refer to Agent Ukelele). Dr. Clef was forced to kill Dáiríne in front of Epon in Cornwell, England (refer to A Suicide Story/Addendum 166-E)(location refer to Agent Ukelele). Eventually Dr. Clef somehow delivered Epon to a group of nun in Cornwell (refer to Addendum 166-A). The foundation later discovered her and assigned her as SCP-166.

Sources:
A Suicide Story
SCP-166
Agent Ukelele

To understand the classification used by Global Occult Coalition, Refer to Excerpts from PHYSICS Division Threat Entity Database

item.content:encoded:
I agree. The entry should be deleted.

Reasoning
SCP-4999 only appear 20 minutes before the death of a solitary person, in front of the said person which should have terminally poor health, critically injured. Although anyone with clearance level above Level-2 is able to handle and use SCP-978, I don't think the higher ups will allow a person in said condition to use SCP-978. I mean, they should be under medical support and taken care by staff and should not be able to roam around the facility.

Conclusion
In my opinion,the entry should not exist and should be deleted.

item.title: Staff Post - Open
item.content:encoded:
With the permission of Rewrite Team captain Modern_Erasmus, I will be restructuring this page. Notable changes:

  • The personnel log is being restructured! Rather thank keeping everything in a rough chronological order, entries will be rearranged alphabetically, based primarily on the last name of given personnel. The exception is entries which are clearly linked to one another.
  • With the changes comes a pruning: all characters must appear in at least one non-collab work, beyond simply a named cameo. Unnamed characters are excepted from this rule on a case by case basis.
  • It is additionally projected that certain entries may be pruned based on a combination of quality, feasibility, and how much they add to the narrative as a whole.

Thank you for your patience!

EDIT: As the first four tests establish a baseline, they will remain unaffected
